description: Check whether an IP address or a domain is on email blocklists (DNSBL/RBL): Spamhaus ZEN and DBL, SpamCop, Barracuda, UCEPROTECT, Mailspike, SURBL, URIBL and others. For a domain, its own name is checked on domain lists and its A/AAAA addresses on IP lists. Use when mail bounces with 'listed'/'blocked' errors or lands in spam, or after a server was compromised. Lists that refuse queries from public resolvers are reported as not tested, never as listed. Returns listed lists with the reason and a delisting link. For SPF/DKIM/DMARC use check_email_domain.

input.description: Public IPv4/IPv6 address of the sending mail server, or a domain, e.g. 203.0.113.10 or example.com

name: check_dnsbl

error.description: Error code when ok is false

ok.description: false when the check could not run (see error / message)

title: DNSBL / blocklist check
